source.description: The Pocket CMO reel analyzer by the same author (MIT), packaged as a skill: bundled Python scripts for download, frames, cut detection, Groq transcription, and outlier ranking by views divided by followers, plus a reference file of reel pattern names.

dependencies: uv (runs the latest yt-dlp via uvx) or a system yt-dlp
Optional: META_ACCESS_TOKEN for the own Instagram business account mode
